notablePrerequisites:
Moonsnare Specialist does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
description:
Declare Moonsnare Specialist as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Moonsnare Specialist from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moonsnare Specialist's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moonsnare Specialist onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Moonsnare Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning up to one creature to its owner's hand.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.
